caption: The drawing depicts a statue of a standing male figure with medium to dark bronze and gold coloring, accented with highlights and shadows to suggest the material's shine. The figure is positioned upright on a rectangular wooden base that is brown with lighter accents. The statue wears a short draped cloth around the waist, patterned with diagonal lines and geometric shapes, and a sash draped over the left shoulder and across the body. The figure's right hand is resting on the chest, while the left hangs down by the side. The person depicted has defined facial features and is adorned with a feathered headdress. The feet are sandaled and the left foot is slightly in front of the right. The background is light beige and plain, without any additional objects or scenery. The artist's name, "Verna Tallman," is written in the lower right corner.
title: Carved Wooden Indian
